name: HandoverCommissioningTracker
tagline: Commission every system and hand over on time – tests, witnesses, O&M and readiness in one app.
description: Complete construction commissioning and handover module for Power Apps and Power Pages: pre-functional, functional and integrated tests sequenced per building system, O&M manuals, as-builts, training and certificates, witness and acceptance workflow with open issues and attempts, readiness by system and discipline and a countdown to practical completion.
features: Commissioning levels L3 → L4 → L5 sequenced per system
Witness / acceptance rules: open issues, witness name, segregation
Rejection reasons, attempts and repeat-failure flags
Readiness % by system, discipline and level with RAG thresholds
Countdown to handover and after-handover flags
System matrix with status chips and next actions
Bulk submit / accept / reschedule, chase and witness-request texts
Demo mode, phone layout, keyboard and screen-reader support
